KB_Config.Description: User behavior clustering analysis to identify suspicious access patterns and bot activity

Query_Elastic.query: FROM .ds-kibana_sample_data_logs-* | WHERE @timestamp >= "2025-10-21T00:00:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2025-11-28T00:00:00.000Z" | EVAL es_timestamp = DATE_TRUNC(1 hour, @timestamp) | STATS request_count = COUNT(*), unique_ips = COUNT_DISTINCT(clientip), avg_bytes = AVG(bytes), status_404_count = COUNT(*) WHERE response == "404" BY es_timestamp | SORT es_timestamp
